title: TEMP-TABLE built and returned BY-REFERENCE — maps to a Java record list / in-memory table, coupling caller and callee
sourceContent:
/* build-order-lines.p - build a temp-table of order lines for the caller */
DEFINE INPUT  PARAMETER piOrder AS INTEGER NO-UNDO.
DEFINE OUTPUT PARAMETER TABLE FOR ttOrderLine.

DEFINE TEMP-TABLE ttOrderLine NO-UNDO
    FIELD OrderNum AS INTEGER
    FIELD ItemNum  AS CHARACTER
    FIELD Qty      AS INTEGER
    FIELD LineAmt  AS DECIMAL
    INDEX idxOrder IS PRIMARY OrderNum ItemNum.

FOR EACH OrderLine WHERE OrderLine.OrderNum = piOrder NO-LOCK:
    CREATE ttOrderLine.
    ASSIGN ttOrderLine.OrderNum = OrderLine.OrderNum
           ttOrderLine.ItemNum  = OrderLine.ItemNum
           ttOrderLine.Qty      = OrderLine.Qty
           ttOrderLine.LineAmt  = OrderLine.Qty * OrderLine.Price.
END.
notes: DEFINE TEMP-TABLE creates an in-memory, indexed relational table; OUTPUT PARAMETER TABLE passes it to the caller (coupling). The Java target is a List<OrderLine record> (or an in-memory H2 table if the caller queries it by index). The extractor must name the temp-table, note the index and the BY-REFERENCE/return coupling, and capture the FOR EACH NO-LOCK read.
